English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us A misleading photo of a bus said to be set on fire by the JVP Misleading A rumor is circulating on social media stating that a bus has been set on fire by the JVP along with a photograph of the same. “Oh God Jeppo did these things for us, Didn’t they?” by Anonymous | December 22, 2021 A rumor is circulating on social media stating that a bus has been set on fire by the JVP along with a photograph of the same. “Oh God Jeppo did these things for us, Didn’t they?” Source- https://www.facebook.com/100071988999905/posts/138970445179255/ Our technical investigation to clarify the news revealed that the photo was taken on September 27, 2016 of a bus accident with 46 school children in Guangzhou , China. All 46 children survived the crash and no one was reported dead from the accident. Source- https://www.thatsmags.com/china/post/15626/46-children-escape-burning-bus-in-guangzhou To read more- South China Morning Post – https://www.scmp.com/news/china/society/article/2023291/guangzhou-schoolchildren-saved-burning-bus-passers Tencent News – https://cutt.ly/IUqVKhB Therefore, it reveals that this photo is of a bus accident that took place on September 27,2016 in Guangzhou, China where 46 school children also met with the accident. The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
